decisions.reason: Reusing a location-site template does not change the master site's role, location links, or navigation requirements.
The client explicitly requires packages and prices to remain consistent across the copied location websites, adding a booking-configuration constraint.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Well it’s really creating one type of website that is the same thru out all websites which we copy and paste and just change branding and wording. All packages and prices stay the same

value_updates.package_and_price_consistency: All packages and prices stay the same across location websites

decisions.reason: Uniform packages and prices do not alter the established separation of bookings, payouts, calendars, revenue, sales, or location management.
The template-reuse decision does not change the existing design reference or simple, easy-to-navigate layout characteristics.
Location-specific branding and wording can coexist with the established Smash Room brand identity; the source does not change the shared brand name or its application.
